summary: Graviton support added for PyTorch 1.12.1 and TensorFlow 2.9.1 inference. Changes: src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/pytorch.json and tensorflow.json (graviton added to inference processors; new 1.12.1 / 2.9.1 versions with a graviton sub-entry for the -graviton repositories, container version ubuntu20.04-sagemaker); src/sagemaker/image_uris.py (_processor maps Graviton families like c6g/t4g to "graviton"; retrieve uses the graviton repo and cpu-tagged URI, raises ValueError for Graviton on versions without a Graviton image, and rejects x86 instance types on Graviton-only versions). Both spec examples return the expected URIs when a version is passed explicitly (version is required for PyTorch/TensorFlow since there is no default). Tests: tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_retrieve.py 24 passed; test_dlc_frameworks.py + tests/unit/test_pytorch.py 1447 passed. Jumpstart image tests not run: the shared venv lacks the mock package, so I used a temporary PYTHONPATH shim in /tmp (nothing installed into the venv). No new unit tests added and nothing committed.
